_comment: Declared, migrated breaks of a struct's storage layout. check-core-storage-layout.sh requires every struct reachable from a proxied contract's storage to extend its baseline append-only. A break passes only when an entry here matches the contract, the struct, the layout hash of the baseline struct (from) and the layout hash of the live struct (to). `scripts/ci/storage_layout_nested.py hashes <snapshot>` prints the hashes. `migration` is the Contract.function that rewrites every legacy entry in the same upgrade transaction (upgradeToAndCall); --require-migrations checks that the function is in the contract's ABI. Do not add an entry for a break that no migration repairs.

migrations.reason: v0.9.0 replaced `limit` (slot 3) with `closed, exitFeeBps, minHold, maxRoll, createdAt, expiryEpoch` and moved `closed` out of slot 4. A legacy request decodes as garbage. The queue migration normalises every legacy request into the v0.9.0 layout.

v0.9.0 replaced `depositBoundPrice, redeemBoundPrice` (slots 1 and 2) with `matchedShares, matchedUsdc, matchSharePrice` (slots 1 to 3): every member after slot 0 moved by one slot. The queue migration normalises every legacy settlement into the v0.9.0 layout.
v0.9.0 dropped `keeperGrace` from the middle of `_stepParams`: every later member moved down. The rebalancer migration rewrites `_stepParams`.
RebalancerV2 is the Rebalancer plus one marker getter (contracts/test/helpers/FundUpgradeV2.sol) and inherits its layout and its migration.
